title: [Improvement] Handle a large number of React components inside Canvas
reason: Requests better canvas performance for applications rendering hundreds or thousands of interactive OCR boxes as custom React shape components. No discussion was available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's scene renderer replays a document IR through canvas rather than rendering one React component per shape; the architecture-specific cost is not analogous. Varve already has workload benchmarks for large node counts.

title: Canvas blanks ~1-2s after load on iPadOS 26.5 WebKit — reproduces with a stock empty <Tldraw />
reason: The report claims a stock empty editor loses pixels after 1–2 seconds on iPadOS 26.5. The first reply says the same iPad no longer reproduces it as of 2026-07-31 and reports the canvas remains rendered; the author thanks them. No cause is confirmed.

varveAssessment.assessment: The transient WebKit report no longer reproduces upstream; no Varve iPadOS device validation was performed.

title: Slow Zero query materialization warnings recurring on production tldraw.com
reason: Production Zero query materialization still shows extreme comment/file-visitor latency, superseding the earlier preview-only explanation in #9731. The sole reply says it is fixed in an upcoming Zero version; deployment confirmation is not present.

varveAssessment.assessment: This is hosted sync-query service performance and has no corresponding backend in Varve.

title: Drawn comment reactions example fails to add a drawn reaction
reason: Reports the upstream collaboration example's drawn reaction failing allowed-set validation after the user confirms a custom drawn reaction. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: This is an example for the upstream comments package; Varve has no comments reaction feature.

title: Board history snapshots are written more often than the 8 second persist interval
reason: Reports production hosted-board history snapshots being written more frequently than the intended eight-second interval, increasing R2 storage and history noise. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Server-side R2 snapshot persistence is outside Varve's local undo/history persistence path.

title: Comments sidebar closes and style panel appears when using the comment tool
reason: Reports a jarring panel transition in which opening the comment tool closes the comments sidebar and placing a comment opens style controls. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: The interacting comments tool/panel state does not exist in Varve.

title: Comments: add a context menu item for leaving a comment
reason: Requests starting a comment from the canvas context menu rather than switching to the comment tool; the sole comment seconds the idea. This is a discoverability feature for hosted comments.

varveAssessment.assessment: No context-menu command for starting a local comment can be added without a comments feature; no product scope is implied.

title: Comments: Show the full date and time when hovering over the comment's time
reason: Requests exposing an exact comment timestamp on hover while retaining relative time at a glance. The issue includes a screenshot, not replayed in this review; no comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: This is a comments byline feature absent from Varve; no local timestamp behavior is assessed.

title: Comment visibility toggle uses non-tldraw eye icons
reason: Requests replacing small, thin Radix eye icons in the comments visibility toggle with the upstream design-system eye icons. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: The affected comments visibility control does not exist in Varve.

title: Region comment pin shifts down and to the left when the draft is posted
reason: The reply confirms #9855 corrected the region pin offset to half the pin size so the committed pin matches the draft corner position.

varveAssessment.assessment: This is an upstream region comment anchor fix; no local comment-pin implementation exists.
